name: Montana

statute.name: Montana Public Records Act
statute.citation: Mont. Code Ann. § 2-6-1001 et seq.; Mont. Const. art. II, § 9

response.rule_text: No statutory, regulatory or court-set deadline; copies must be made available in a timely manner (§ 2-6-1006(2)).

fees.copy_rule: Fees may not exceed actual costs incident to fulfilling the request (§ 2-6-1006(3)); agency may charge customization costs if it agrees to customize (§ 2-6-1006(4),(5)).
fees.waiver_rule: No code sections on fee waivers.

residency.rule_text: Any person may request under § 2-6-1006 without regard to residence (Krakauer, 2016, per RCFP).

appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; petition district court directly, no time limit; written denial explanation required (§ 2-6-1009).

exemptions_citation: Mont. Code Ann. § 2-6-1002(1); Mont. Const. art. II, § 9 balancing test
format_rule: Electronic records treated like printed; requester may choose format; oral requests allowed though AG says writing may be required (37 A.G. Op. 107).
notes: RCFP: executive branch covered except exempt; no court has addressed legislative records; universities not directly addressed (Krakauer involved Commissioner of Higher Education). Statute URL not fetched. Page truncated at 100k chars.
